prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE final 2D character-design sheet for the named person in this request, part of a coherent avatar collection. Render the person's own recognisable identity in the user's selected classic Dragon Ball-inspired cel-animation style.
INPUT ROLES:
Image 1 is the CURRENT approved SVG model-sheet preview of THIS PERSON, exported from the repository. It is the only reference for identity, facial proportions, hair, body, clothing and personal accessories. It contains multiple views and facial expressions; redraw one consistent design. Ignore its black preview background.
Image 2 is the chosen Guillermo Aladro 03 design: STYLE ONLY, especially classic anime facial construction and cel shading.
Image 3 is the chosen Ander 04 design: STYLE ONLY, especially confident thick outer ink, thinner interior lines and broad clear shadow shapes.
Never transfer either style-reference man's face, hairstyle, beard, body, clothes or accessories to this person. Preserve the person in Image 1, including their adult age appearance and feminine or masculine features as shown.
Style: unmistakable hand-drawn 2D anime, classic Dragon Ball cel-animation language with semirealistic likeness. Expressive stylized eyes, individual eyebrow/nose/mouth/jaw construction; hair grouped into readable illustrated shapes while preserving the actual length, curl pattern and silhouette; confident dark contours with controlled line weight; flat local colors with 1-2 crisp cel shadows per material. No photorealistic skin, no 3D, no painterly effects or dramatic colored lights. No generic Goku or Vegeta face.
Composition: portrait 4:5 sheet, plain warm-white background. At left show ONE complete full-body standing frontal three-quarter figure, natural relaxed pose from the source, with complete hair, both feet and all outfit accessories fully inside the canvas with a clear margin. At right show ONE enlarged head-and-shoulders portrait of precisely the same person and design, face unobstructed. Keep the head shape, hairstyle, clothing, jewelry and color palette internally consistent between figure and portrait. The second depiction is a portrait inset, not a second character. Natural adult body proportions, coherent anatomy, no extra limbs.
Only the small clean top-left name specified below; no other text, no watermark. No alternate outfits, extra characters, costumes, auras or powers. One final design, no variants.
Specific person and invariant details:
LAURA: adult woman with a natural slim build and light warm skin, long softly oval feminine face, light gray-green/hazel eyes, delicate gently arched brows, fairly long straight nose and softly smiling lips. Long straight chestnut-brown hair parted just off-center, reaching well below her shoulders; preserve the warm brown color and mostly straight silhouette. Medium rounded GOLD hoop earrings visible at both ears. White fitted sleeveless halter-style top with straps passing around the neck, a rounded scoop neckline, subtle vertical rib texture, no sleeves and no black trim. The top remains opaque white with soft gray cel shadows and a complete clean outline. Light-wash high-rise straight blue jeans and gray-white low-top sneakers. Both hands in front jeans pockets, relaxed upright stance. No necklace, no tattoos, no extra jewelry. Retain her individual adult feminine facial features and natural proportions, without sexualization or exaggerated anime anatomy. Same hair, gold hoops and white halter straps in figure and portrait.
Text (verbatim): "LAURA".
